items.title: ‘Take my money’ – Chelsea fans say ‘I need this’ as club release ’11 out of 10′ third kit ahead of Hull clash
items.summary: CHELSEA fans gushed as the Blues released their new third strip. The new design is based on Chelsea's away kit from the first two seasons of the Premier League. Primarily white, the shirt includes blue trim and thin red pinstripes. It also features the club's old badge, rather than the current one.
